summaryZh: Godula Lab研究糖链如何在细胞与环境的边界编码和传递生物信息。实验室开发化学与材料策略以截获、分析并改写这些信息，探索通过靶向糖链推进生物医学研究的途径。
researchQuestions: 糖链如何在细胞与环境的边界编码和传递生物信息？
如何通过化学与材料策略分析和改写这些信息？

evidence.quote: Chemical glycobiology to understand and control disease processes

Our research program in chemical glycobiology is broadly interested in gaining an understanding of how glycans encode and transmit biological information at the boundary between cells and their environment.
To achieve this objective, we develop chemical and materials-based strategies to intercept, analyze and, ultimately, rewrite this information .
Our ultimate goal is to explore new avenues for targeting glycans to advance biomedical research and human health.
